title: 文档全家桶

editor_note.text: 交稿前的最后一公里:docx 出正式文档,xlsx 管表格和公式,pptx 出片子,pdf 做合并、拆页、盖水印这类收尾活。建议先和 Claude 在对话里把内容聊定,再让对应技能出文件——内容和排版分开走,返工少一半。四件都是 Anthropic 官方出品。复杂版式别一把梭,先让它出一页样张,确认了再继续。
editor_note.author: 主理人
editor_note.text_en: The last mile before handing in: docx for formal documents, xlsx for sheets and formulas, pptx for decks, pdf for merging, splitting, watermarks and other finishing work. Settle the content in conversation with Claude first, then let the skill produce the file — separating content from layout halves the rework. All four are official Anthropic skills. For complex layouts, don't go all in at once: get one sample page, confirm, then continue.

tagline_en: Word, Excel, PPT, PDF — ready to hand in
